# Siavash Akbari — Photographer, Graphic Designer, Videographer & Content Creator

> Multidisciplinary creative professional and studio based in Isfahan (Esfahan), Iran. Specializing in high-end commercial photography, brand identity systems, video production, and social media content creation.

## Overview
- **Name:** Siavash Akbari (سیاوش اکبری)
- **Role:** Photographer, Graphic Designer, Videographer, Content Creator, Creative Director
- **Location:** Isfahan, Iran (اصفهان، ایران)
- **Website:** https://www.siavashakbari.ir
- **Email:** Siavakbari@gmail.com

## Core Services & Disciplines

### 1. Photography (عکاسی در اصفهان)
- **Commercial & Advertising Photography (عکاسی تبلیغاتی و صنعتی):** High-impact imagery for brands, factories, and commercial campaigns.
- **Fashion Photography (عکاسی مد و فشن):** Lookbooks, editorial fashion, modeling, and apparel stories.
- **Food & Beverage Photography (عکاسی غذا و رستوران):** Culinary narratives for restaurants, cafes, and food packaging.
- **Portrait Photography (عکاسی پرتره):** Expressive studio and environmental portraits.
- **Product Photography (عکاسی محصول):** Crisp catalog, e-commerce, and commercial product shoots.

### 2. Graphic Design (طراحی گرافیک در اصفهان)
- **Visual Identity & Branding (هویت بصری و طراحی لوگو):** Comprehensive brand guidelines, typography, and visual systems.
- **Book Cover Design (طراحی جلد کتاب):** Editorial layouts, typography, and jacket design for publishers.
- **Poster Design (طراحی پوستر):** Cultural, exhibition, and promotional posters.

### 3. Videography & Motion (فیلمبرداری و تیزر تبلیغاتی)
- **Commercial Teasers & Video Production (ساخت تیزر تبلیغاتی و ویدیو):** High-end video production, color grading, and sound-synced editing in Isfahan and across Iran.
- **Motion Design (موشن دیزاین):** Dynamic typographic animation and visual pacing.

### 4. Content Creation & Social Media (تولید محتوا و شبکه‌های اجتماعی)
- **Instagram & Social Media Content (تولید محتوای اینستاگرام):** Strategic visual assets, video reels, and aesthetic feed design to drive brand engagement.
